instruction: In the Employee Performance Evaluation Summary, add 'Excellent Count' as a header in cell AA1, then use COUNTIF formulas in cells AA2 through AA8 to count the number of 'Excellent' ratings each employee received across the rating columns (J through Z).

command: import pyautogui; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); import time; time.sleep(1)

metadata.capability_extraction: Can read spreadsheet data in LibreOffice Calc, navigate file system, open terminal, install Python packages, write Python scripts, interact with cells
metadata.failure_analysis: Original task was too complex: transferring data from Excel to 7 individual PDF forms programmatically. Model spent most turns installing packages and writing scripts, never completing PDF generation.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed the data analysis aspect of the original task into a formula-based summary. Tests model's ability to use COUNTIF formulas in LibreOffice Calc to analyze the performance ratings.
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a header in AA1 and COUNTIF formulas in AA2:AA8 counting 'Excellent' across J:Z per employee. Getter reads AA1 header and AA2:AA8 values. Metric gives 0.2 for header and 0.8/7 per correct count. Expected: John Doe=8, Emily Johnson=15, Michael Brown=0, Linda Green=15, David Wilson=0, Sophia Carter=15, Alex Lee=9.
